text: 本周（9月28日至9月30日）中国央行公开市场将有7033亿元逆回购到期，其中周一至周三分别到期6603亿元、350亿元、80亿元
text_en: This week (September 28 to September 30), 703.3 billion yuan of reverse repos will mature in the PBOC's open market operations, with 660.3 billion yuan, 35 billion yuan, and 8 billion yuan maturing on Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday respectively
